extraction.name: Kalita Wave 25:400
extraction.short_description: A dose-multiple pour schedule finishing at 400g water
extraction.preparation: Dose in 25 grams of coffee, medium-fine grind, and give the filter a rinse first with water around 93 degrees Celsius. We're using a Gabi Dripmaster underneath today -- just a heads up, that thing's got a 120 milliliter reservoir built in, so keep an eye on it if you're brewing anything bigger.

steps.raw_text: Dose in 25 grams of coffee, medium-fine grind, and give the filter a rinse first with water around 93 degrees Celsius. We're using a Gabi Dripmaster underneath today -- just a heads up, that thing's got a 120 milliliter reservoir built in, so keep an eye on it if you're brewing anything bigger.
Start your timer and bloom up to three times the dose, so about 75 grams, nice and even, and let it sit for a bit.

Once that settles, start your second pour, pouring in slow circles -- you'll pass through five times the dose, around 125 grams, on your way -- and keep going up to eight times the dose, 200 grams even.
Then keep pouring in slow circles, roughly 5 grams a second, until you reach the full 400 grams.
From there just let it draw down completely.
